fullPassage: The 1940s witnessed the emergence of what was initially referred to as a miracle fiber. Polyester, the chemical compound derived from crude oil, seemed to offer everything that people wanted in a fabric; it was durable, lightweight, quick-drying, and low-maintenance. These advantages appealed to consumers who had their sights set on a more comfortable lifestyle, so its popularity surged. However, by the end of the 1970s, the market became oversaturated, causing factories to shut down. Polyester then gained the image of a cheap, tasteless, inferior material, and people began to seek natural fibers. It did not help either that the oil crisis of the 1970s resulted in consumer awareness of its dependence on crude oil and its ecological impact. It would take decades for polyester to be revived, yet it did come back, thanks to technology. With advancements in manufacturing processes, the quality of polyester improved, making it a popular choice in the fashion industry once again. Still, concerns about its impact on the environment linger to this day, suggesting the possibility that it may experience another decline in the future.

Polyester, the chemical compound derived from crude oil, seemed to offer everything that people wanted in a fabric; it was durable, lightweight, quick-drying, and low-maintenance. These advantages appealed to consumers who had their sights set on a more comfortable lifestyle, so its popularity surged. However, by the end of the 1970s, the market became oversaturated, causing factories to shut down. Polyester then gained the image of a cheap, tasteless, inferior material, and people began to seek natural fibers. It did not help either that the oil crisis of the 1970s resulted in consumer awareness of its dependence on crude oil and its ecological impact. It would take decades for polyester to be revived, yet it did come back, thanks to technology. With advancements in manufacturing processes, the quality of polyester improved, making it a popular choice in the fashion industry once again. Still, concerns about its impact on the environment linger to this day, suggesting the possibility that it may experience another decline in the future.

그것을 패션 산업에서 인기 있는 선택으로 만들며
[조건] (1) a, choice, fashion, in, industry, it, making, popular, the 를 모두 사용 (2) 9단어로 쓸 것

→ 'making + 목적어(it) + 목적보어(a popular choice)' 구조로 이어요.

→ '패션 산업에서'는 in the fashion industry로 마무리해요.
